trail.no_session_body: A trail shows one session as a story: what it was asked, what it did, and how it ended.
trail.inputs_sub: The request that started this session, and what the agent knew going in.
trail.request_missing: No messages were captured for this session, so the request is unknown.
trail.request_none: This session has no user prompt on record. It may have been started by a schedule or another agent.
trail.context_not_captured: ClawMetry does not yet record instructions or the tool list for this runtime. This card shows only information from the transcript.
trail.context_empty_runtime: This runtime does not expose what the agent knew, so there is nothing to show here.
trail.ctx_grew: The tool list changed during the session. This view combines the tools available at different times.
trail.ctx_changed_keys: Changed during the session: {keys}. Showing the last.
trail.ctx_changed: Recorded {n} times during the session. Showing the last.
trail.ctx_rewritten: Rewritten during the session. Showing the fullest version.
trail.decisions_sub: Every step, in order. Replay the conversation, or open the timing and trace views.
trail.view_unavailable: This view is not available here.
trail.view_failed: This view could not be drawn.
trail.tree_unavailable: The replay tree is not available here. The Replay view has the full conversation.
trail.tree_empty: No replay tree yet for this runtime. The Replay view above has the full conversation.
trail.tree_truncated: This session is longer than the replay can show. The first {n} events are listed.
trail.workflow_run_data_unavailable: The node runs of this execution are not stored in the database.
trail.in_flight_title: Still running when this turn started.
trail.branch_note: Branch points in this conversation: {n}. The replay follows the active branch.
trail.branch_note_hidden: Entries on other branches, not shown: {n}.
trail.aider_note: Aider keeps prompts, replies, confirmations and applied edits in its history file. It keeps no tool calls and no reasoning, so the replay lists none.
trail.fork_title: This sub-agent started with the full context of its parent.
trail.outcome_sub: Did the result match the request, and what did it cost.
trail.outcome_unknown_why: ClawMetry labels a session once it has ended and the classifier has seen it. On the hosted dashboard the label travels with the next sync.
trail.outcome_success_why: It finished the task and stopped cleanly.
trail.outcome_failed_why: It hit an error or gave up before finishing.
trail.outcome_escalated_why: It stopped to ask a person before going on.
trail.outcome_cognitive_loop_why: It kept repeating itself without making progress.
trail.outcome_tool_call_stuck_why: A tool it called never came back.
trail.outcome_waiting_why: It is open and idle at its prompt, waiting for you to say something.
trail.quality_none: Not scored yet. The judge scores a session after it ends, on the machine your agent runs on.
trail.score_tooltip: Quality score from the judge, out of 5
trail.cost_unknown: Cost not known for this session: no price for its model.
trail.cost_none: No cost was recorded for this session.
trail.spend_unknown: Spend and duration are not known for this session yet.
trail.git_not_captured: Not captured yet. ClawMetry does not link commits and pull requests to this session on this machine.
trail.git_off: Git outcomes are off on this machine.
trail.git_none: No commits or pull requests were made while this session ran.

overview.hb_banner_silent: No agent heartbeat for {gap}. The expected interval is {interval} minutes. Make sure that the agent is active.
overview.hb_banner_delayed: The last heartbeat arrived {gap} ago. The expected interval is {interval} minutes.
alerts.builtins_note: These monitors run without custom rules. They produce the red banners at the top of the dashboard. Alerts appear here and in channels connected through Notifications. Use a switch to mute a monitor. Select a channel to change where its alerts go.
guard.policies_sub: A policy can act automatically when a detector reports a condition. New policies start in monitor mode. They record the proposed action without changing the agent. An enabled policy can escalate its actions over time. For example, it can pause an agent, then kill it five minutes later if the condition continues. Each step requires the condition to remain active when the waiting period ends.
guard.agent_reported_sub: Notes that agents sent through the ClawMetry MCP tool are counted by category. This view also shows how often an agent reported the same condition as a detector. Uncorroborated means that no independent evidence was found. It does not mean that the report is false.
security.findings_sub: Recorded findings remain available after a scan. They include reports from connected security tools. Open a row to read its source session.
alerts.delivery_body: No delivery channel is configured. ClawMetry can show this one in the app, or deliver it to Slack, Telegram, or PagerDuty.
alerts.delivery_footnote: In-app alerts show in the bell menu and as a banner across the top.
